dataset: NASA Blue Marble Next Generation, September 2004
projection: north-up equirectangular; west -180, east +180; north +90, south -90
colorSpace: 8-bit SDR RGB, sRGB display-encoded visualization, embedded sRGB ICC profile; full-range YUV 4:2:0 AVIF; no HDR or EXIF orientation metadata
processing: Lanczos downsample; geographic wrapped/clamped padding; AVIF quality 55, speed 6, encoded directly from native-source RGB mosaics. No intermediate lossy re-encoding, upscaling, generated detail, recoloring, or sharpening.
credit: NASA Earth Observatory / NASA GSFC / Reto Stoeckli
